summary: Concord performs no model resolution: the adapter omits --model from lane dispatch and OpenCode resolves the executing model from host configuration; readback_model is the sole model evidence feeding CD-0017 D6 distinctness; the routing-policy record, the CONCORD_ROUTING_POLICY host state, the load-time validation, and the five declared-side worker-attempt columns (routing_policy_version, routing_policy_digest, resolved_model, resolution_role, fallback_reason) are retired under a schema migration; CD-0017 D2's dispatch flag is dropped and D8/D9 retire.
title: Concord performs no model routing
